Keys.title: AI Provider Keys
Keys.subtitle: Saouti is 100% BYOK (Bring Your Own Key). Your key is stored encrypted and only used for your generation runs.
Keys.keyPlaceholder: Paste your Gemini API key (e.g. AIzaSy...)
Keys.saveSuccess: API key validated and securely encrypted.
Keys.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove your API key? Generation will be disabled until you add a new one.
Keys.noKeyBanner: Add your Gemini API key to start writing.
Keys.guideTitle: How to get a free Gemini API key
Keys.step1Desc: Go to aistudio.google.com and sign in with your Google account.
Keys.step2Desc: Click 'Get API key', then click 'Create API key in new project'.
Keys.step3Desc: Copy your generated key and paste it here in Saouti.
Keys.freeTierNoticeBody: Google's free-tier terms state that prompts and responses may be reviewed by human reviewers and used to improve Google products. Paid tiers do not permit model training.
Keys.providerTermsLink: Read Google API Terms of Service
Keys.consentCheckbox: I understand that free-tier API keys may permit Google to review and use data per their terms.
Keys.emptyUsage: No AI calls recorded in the last 7 days.

Onboarding.step3Desc: Who reads your posts, their expertise level, and interests
Onboarding.step4Desc: What you want to achieve on each social platform
Onboarding.step5Desc: Formality level, length, hook style, and Arabic dialect options

Onboarding.step7Desc: Target platforms and specific subreddit rules
